jobs_results.description:
Business Intelligence Analyst - Sales Analytics Join to apply for the Business Intelligence Analyst - Sales Analytics role at U.S. Bank At U.S. Bank, we're on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever‐growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

Responsible for working on big data/analytics projects that gather and integrate large volumes of data, perform analysis, interpret results, and develop actionable insights and recommendations for use across the company. Acquires data from multiple data sources in order to perform analysis. Identifies, analyzes and interprets trends or patterns in complex data in order to provide answers to business questions as well as provide recommendations for action. Interprets data and analyzes results using various statistical techniques and tools.

Presents data and analysis in a clear and concise manner allowing the audience to quickly understand the results/recommendations, so they act upon them and make data‐driven decisions. Collaborate with various partners to provide a holistic view of the analysis. Measures and monitors results of applied recommendations and presents adjustments. Ensures all data acquisition, sharing and results of applied recommendations are compliant with company standards. This role has an emphasis on sales reporting utilizing data from Salesforce and Oracle, powered by Microsoft Fabric tools.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent work experience Five to Seven years of data analytics experience Preferred Skills/Experience Direct experience writing complex queries in SQL from scratch. Strong data visualization skills using Power BI (preferred), Tableau, Looker, or equivalent. Exposure to Azure SQL Database, Microsoft Fabric, and Oracle. Experience using Salesforce data objects and incorporating this data into analytics solutions. Experience in analytics, advanced analytics/statistics, predictive modeling.

Strong analytic skills with the ability to extract, collect, organize, analyze and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets. Demonstrated project management skills. Effective interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills. Hybrid/flexible schedule : there is an in‐office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship . If there's anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Healthcare (medical, dental, vision) Basic term and optional term life insurance Short‐term and long‐term disability Pregnancy disability and parental leave 401(k) and employer‐funded retirement plan Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure) Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities Adoption assistance Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law. job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: In this role, you will serve as the functional linchpin between operational stakeholders and technical engineering teams across the enterprise

You will analyze, document, and manage business and system requirements bridging the DHA Financial Management suite—centered on Oracle Federal Financials (OFF R12)—and the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) business intelligence data marts

Your day-to-day focus will center on capturing business needs from DHA Contract Resource Management (CRM) financial managers, translating federal statutory mandates into system requirements, conducting rigorous cross-system gap analyses, maintaining end-to-end traceability, and supporting user acceptance testing across reporting repositories such as the Financial Reporting Data Mart (FRDM / Contractor Resource Center), Operations Reporting Data Mart (ORDM), Pharmacy Reporting Data Mart (PRDM), and the Capital and Direct Medical Education (CAP/DME) reporting area
Requirements Discovery & Comprehensive Gap Analysis
Actively interface with DHA CRM financial managers, DHA Office of General Counsel (OGC), and operational users to identify business problems and elicit functional system needs

Conduct comprehensive cross-system gap analysis whenever changes occur (e.g., analyzing how upstream configuration or accounting rule adjustments in Oracle Federal Financials affect downstream EDW staging, archival layers, and data mart reports)
Provide business analysis and requirements definitions for reporting reconciliations, data discrepancies, and workflow improvements
System Requirements Documentation & RTM Governance

Author, maintain, and update formal System Requirements Specifications (SRSs) for DHA ECS applications and operational interfaces (CDRL 0010), coordinating reviews to secure formal Government Contracting Officer Representative (COR) digital signatures

Build and maintain a bi-directional Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) for each application release, establishing complete traceability from initial stakeholder requirements through design specifications, software version builds, and test cases

Attach approved requirements packages and RTMs to Change Requests within the Solutions Business Manager (SBM) and Quality Center (QC) repositories to facilitate review by the Configuration Working Group (CWG) and Configuration Management Board (CMB)
Federal Mandates & Enterprise Initiative Analysis
Provide dedicated business analysis, functional data modeling, and test coordination for key contract initiatives:

Government Invoicing (G-Invoicing): Analyze Intragovernmental Transactions (IGT) Buy/Sell business rules, General Terms and Conditions (GT&C), orders, performance, and fund settlement integration with OFF

BEA SFIS, Data Act & SLOA Compliance: Perform annual business analysis of the DoD Business Enterprise Architecture (BEA) standard release; define system and reporting changes required to sustain Standard Financial Information Structure (SFIS), Data Act, and Standard Line of Accounting (SLOA) compliance across OFF and EDW

Central Accounting Reporting System (CARS): Define functional requirements for ingesting and processing the CARS Transactional Data Extract (CTDE) within OFF and EDW to automate daily cash and disbursement reconciliations for Agency Location Code 97000012

Line of Accounting (LOA) & Common Cost Accounting Structure (CCAS): Perform functional requirements discovery and document data dictionary additions across OFF and EDW to support cost accounting reporting

TRICARE Encounter Data System (TEDS) Interface: Analyze updates in TEDS healthcare and pharmacy claims records, mapping schema changes to OFF claims processing extensions and EDW reporting repositories

Capital and Direct Medical Education (CAP/DME): Support functional analysis, data ingestion validation, and specialized financial reporting for CAP/DME data submitted by Managed Care Support Contractors

CRM System Integration Test (CRMSIT): Collaborate directly with the CRM Financial Manager during biennial CRMSIT testing; identify specific test claim scenarios, define modified TED record values, and analyze payment calculation results
Testing, User Acceptance & Defect Management
Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Test Engineers to translate functional business requirements into rigorous test scenarios and scripts within HP Quality Center (QC) / ALM

Support Government User Acceptance Testing (UAT): assist users during test execution, capture test artifacts/screenshots, validate business logic, and help classify test defects as major, moderate, or minor
Verify that software modifications fully satisfy documented business requirements prior to CMB approval and production deployment
Reporting Validation & User Enablement
Validate ad hoc queries and standard reports generated via Oracle Analytics Server (OAS), BI Publisher, and SplashBI to ensure business logic accuracy and accounting integrity
Assist in developing application user training materials, user guides, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support financial and operational users across DHA commands and MTFs
Ensure all functional reporting outputs adhere to Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility criteria
